exchange.title: Tally’s Exchange
exchange.rumourUp: Bean at the café says eggs go up tomorrow. She is usually right.
exchange.rumourDown: Bean at the café says eggs drop tomorrow. She is usually right.
exchange.none: Nothing to sell yet. Your homestead’s hens, goats, cows and sheep make the eggs, milk and wool Tally buys.
exchange.noFarm: Tally buys what a homestead makes, and you don’t have one yet.
exchange.cap: Tally has bought all the {what} she can take from you today.
exchange.busy: The sale didn’t go through. Nothing was sold, so try again in a moment.
exchange.keep: Sales are kept on your Banana Pass, and this device doesn’t have one yet.

orders.paid: Delivered to {who}. Tally paid you {coins} coins.
orders.short: Not enough yet: you have {have} of the {n}. Nothing was taken.
orders.gone: That order was yesterday’s. Today’s are on the board now.
orders.noFarm: Farm orders need a homestead of your own, and you don’t have one yet.
orders.busy: The delivery didn’t go through. Nothing was taken, so try again in a moment.
orders.keep: Deliveries are kept on your Banana Pass, and this device doesn’t have one yet.
orders.allDone: All of today’s orders are delivered. Tally pins up new ones tomorrow.

bean.milk: Milk for the coffee. The grounds say a long queue.
bean.eggs: Eggs for a lemon cake. The grounds say it sells out.
bean.harvest: Fruit for the counter. The grounds say something sweet.

pip.eggs: Eggs for the shelf! The last box was the very last one.
pip.wool: Wool for mittens! A store needs a last pair.
pip.pegg: Park eggs for the store! Found ones go fastest.

stamp.wool: Wool to pad the parcels. Dented ones look worse.
stamp.shell: Shells to hold letters down on windy days. Weighed first.

nib.milk: Milk for the Town Hall. It is recorded as a necessity.

spinner.fish: Fish for the arcade’s tank! Spinner has no fish! A tragedy!

moss.fish: Fish, for supper. The back room smells of it after.

dot.fish: A real fish to draw. The ones people describe wear hats.
dot.pegg: Eggs found in the park. They are on my list of lost things.

twirl.shell: Shells for the wheel’s stand. It likes to look its best.

granfig.harvest: Park crops. Picked ripe, not pretty. Do not bruise them.

figjr.harvest: Fruit for a new lemonade. Gran Fig is the taste test.
